scripts.cap:sync: npm run build && find ios android assets -name '._*' -delete 2>/dev/null; npx cap sync
scripts.cap:ios: npm run cap:sync && npx cap open ios
scripts.cap:android: npm run cap:sync && npx cap open android
scripts.android:apk: npm run cap:sync && cd android && STAYSUITE_BUILD_DIR=${STAYSUITE_BUILD_DIR:-$HOME/Library/Caches/staysuite-android} JAVA_HOME="${JAVA_HOME:-/Applications/Android Studio.app/Contents/jbr/Contents/Home}" ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.assets: node scripts/make-app-assets.mjs && npx capacitor-assets generate --ios --android --iconBackgroundColor '#0f766e' --iconBackgroundColorDark '#0b4f4a' --splashBackgroundColor '#0f766e' --splashBackgroundColorDark '#0c0e0d' && sed -i '' 's/android:inset="16.7%"/android:inset="0%"/' android/app/src/main/res/mipmap-anydpi-v26/*.xml
